source_text: Keratinization of the glans and inner mucosal remnants, a physiological response to exposure post-circumcision, has been hypothesized to alter sensitivity, but meta-analyses of sexual function outcomes find no consistent link to erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, or overall sexual satisfaction impairment.
